rationale: The sunglasses were taken by a wild macaque during the covered trip (Aug 19, within Aug 16-28), which claims manual section 7 (Wild animals) treats as accidental loss under wording section 5, not theft, so no police report is needed and the animal exclusion does not apply. The licensed guide's letter is accepted as evidence and the replacement receipt gives proof of value. On the First plan the per-item limit is $500 and the deductible is $0, so the $240 claimed is paid in full under wording section 10, which is under the $1,000 sign-off threshold. This is the customer's first claim.
